persona: Opened her first and only credit card in May 2026, so her credit file is only a few months old. Checks her score rarely and isn't sure what counts.
interview_basis: 3 of 12 interviewees had no credit card; 3 of 12 didn't know their score.

persona: Pays his one card in full every month and keeps usage low while repaying an education loan. Invests through monthly SIPs.
interview_basis: Most common interview pattern: 1 card, paid in full, under 30% usage, education loan, never late, invests in mutual funds.

persona: Planning to buy a car. Applied for a new credit card in August and pre-applied for a car loan in September, and saw two small dips in a row.
interview_basis: Car purchase was a stated goal for 2 of 12 interviewees; 6 of 12 knew a new application causes a small, temporary dip, but 6 of 12 did not.

persona: Missed a card payment by more than 30 days in March 2026 while travelling, and has paid on time every month since. Also repaying a home loan.
interview_basis: 3 of 12 interviewees had a home loan. No interviewee reported a late payment (11 never, 1 preferred not to say), so this profile exists for coverage of the guide's biggest factor.

persona: Carries a balance above 70% of his card limit, pays more than the minimum but not in full, and took a personal loan and an instant cash app loan to cover expenses. Has little emergency savings.
interview_basis: Based on one interviewee pattern: over 70% card usage, home plus personal loan, more than 35% of pay on repayments, no regular investing, and prior use of an instant cash loan.
